newsitem.title: UK: CBI says UK should keep EMU options open.
newsitem.headline: CBI says UK should keep EMU options open.

text.p: Britain should keep its options open on whether or not it should join the European single currency, the Confederation of British Industry (CBI) said on Wednesday.
"Our policy is that the government should keep the options open," said Adair Turner, CBI director general. "We are not arguing for or against joining."
He said that delaying a decision on EMU could still mean that the UK signed up for the first round in 1999, but could equally mean staying out at that stage.
"We don't need to decide yet," Turner said.
But he said regardless of whether Britain joined up or not it made economic sense to meet the Maastricht criteria which would allow Britain to sign up if it wished to.
